coverDesign.title: Falanaras, Blood Knight

publicationBook.description: After the Scourge destroys Quel’Thalas, bereaved conscript Falanaras rises through Silvermoon’s shattered ranks as his people turn to increasingly desperate means of survival. Drawn into the capture of the naaru M’uru and the founding of the Blood Knights, he must wield stolen Light against his enemies while confronting the suffering that makes that power possible. As Kael’thas’s betrayal and Silvermoon’s alliance with the Horde redraw every loyalty he once understood, Falanaras fights to preserve his people without surrendering the last limits of his conscience.

{
  "content": [
    {
      "accessibilityRole": null,
      "altText": null,
      "content": [
        {
          "marks": [],
          "text": "About the Author",
          "type": "text"
        }
      ],
      "decorative": false,
      "figurePresentation": null,
      "headingLevel": 1,
      "id": "25cc270f-5e98-45c6-b59f-c57e58f350e6",
      "imageId": null,
      "language": null,
      "pageCompositionId": null,
      "paragraphPresentation": null,
      "publicationField": null,
      "styleRole": "chapter-title",
      "type": "heading"
    },
    {
      "accessibilityRole": null,
      "altText": null,
      "content": [
        {
          "marks": [],
          "text": "Jonathan Harmon has been a fan of the Warcraft universe since childhood, beginning with Warcraft II and Warcraft III. The blood elf campaign in Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne was always among his favorites, and Kael\u0027thas became one of the characters who most captured his imagination. When blood elves became playable in World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade, he created his first blood elf character: a paladin named Falanaras, who has remained his main ever since.",
          "type": "text"
        }
      ],
      "decorative": false,
      "figurePresentation": null,
      "headingLevel": null,
      "id": "5b15bd7a-f633-4f88-be27-ae913b4d87ec",
      "imageId": null,
      "language": null,
      "pageCompositionId": null,
      "paragraphPresentation": null,
      "publicationField": null,
      "styleRole": "novel-opening",
      "type": "paragraph"
    },
    {
      "accessibilityRole": null,
      "altText": null,
      "content": [
        {
          "marks": [],
          "text": "The blood elves\u0027 fel-tainted survival, magical hunger, and coercive use of a naaru to forge a dark inversion of the traditional paladin fascinated him. Falanaras, Blood Knight grew from his desire to explore that history more deeply and place his longtime character among the Blood Knights at the order\u0027s creation.",
          "type": "text"
        }
      ],
      "decorative": false,
      "figurePresentation": null,
      "headingLevel": null,
      "id": "9845c2d4-ceb4-4535-83c9-d2a1f7ab2ef0",
